FX-TILE-001.says: The settings as they start: completion 0, so nothing changes.

FX-TILE-002.says: Completion 100: every tile gone, every pixel clear.

FX-TILE-003.says: Completion 50, tiles 4 (tiles 4 pixels wide), radial: the tiles round the middle gone, the next ring shrinking, the corners whole.

FX-TILE-004.says: FX-TILE-003 with shape rectangle: the tiles go in square rings.

FX-TILE-005.says: FX-TILE-003 with shape doors: the tiles go in columns from the middle out, splitting the layer in two.

FX-TILE-006.says: FX-TILE-003 reversed: the corners go first, the middle stays.

FX-TILE-007.says: FX-TILE-003 with border 2: each shrinking tile's edge soft over 2 pixels.

FX-TILE-008.says: FX-TILE-003 with rotation 30: the whole grid turned, not each tile.

FX-TILE-009.says: Center [0, 0], completion 50, tiles 4: the wipe starts from the top-left corner.

FX-TILE-010.says: Tiles 1, completion 10: one tile the drawing's width, four tenths of the way gone, shrunk about the middle.

FX-TILE-011.says: Tiles 2.5, completion 60, rectangle: tile 6.4 pixels wide, so the tiles need not fit the drawing.

FX-TILE-012.says: Completion keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, tiles 4, border 1: frame 2 is completion 50.

FX-TILE-013.says: Rotation keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 40 at frame 4, linear, completion 50, tiles 4: frame 2 is rotation 20.

FX-TILE-014.says: Center keyed from [25, 50] at frame 0 to [75, 50] at frame 4, linear, completion 40, tiles 4, rectangle.

FX-TILE-015.says: FX-TILE-007 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-TILE-016.says: Doors reversed, completion 70, tiles 8, border 0.5: the outer columns gone, a soft middle left.

FX-TILE-017.says: Completion 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-018.says: Completion -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-019.says: Center x 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-020.says: Rotation 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-021.says: Border -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-022.says: Border 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-023.says: Tiles 0.5, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-024.says: Tiles 201, above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-025.says: Shape "Radial": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-026.says: Shape "star": not a shape of Tile Wipe. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-027.says: Reverse "yes": "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILE-028.says: Completion keyed to 200 at frame 4: a key outside the range. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
